SELECT tier, is_current, COUNT(*) AS versions, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, MIN(valid_to) AS min_vt, MAX(valid_to) AS max_vt, MAX(valid_from) AS max_vf
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'multi_current' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'no_current', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'current_vt_not_9999', COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to <> DATE '9999-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'notcurrent_vt_9999', COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE NOT is_current AND valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'valid_on_20261007_gold_members', COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-07' AND valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-07'
UNION ALL SELECT 'current_gold_members', COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND is_current
UNION ALL SELECT 'distinct_tiers', COUNT(DISTINCT tier) FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'future_valid_from', COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from > DATE '2026-10-07'
